comparisonMessage: These preserved learning-era projects show my progression from Java CLI and first CRUD applications to the current Platform Demo's product, architecture, testing, delivery, security, and operations work.

apps.title: Make Change
apps.summary: An early Java exercise using console input, arithmetic, branching, and denomination calculations.

apps.title: Jets
apps.summary: An object-oriented Java application modeling aircraft, pilots, interfaces, inheritance, and interactive menus.

apps.title: Film Query
apps.summary: A Java and JDBC terminal application for querying seeded relational film data.

apps.title: Blackjack
apps.summary: A console blackjack game demonstrating object-oriented modeling, collections, enums, and game-state decisions.

apps.title: Workout JPA CRUD
apps.summary: A first database-backed Spring, JPA, JSP, and MySQL-style CRUD application.

apps.title: VolunteerUp
apps.summary: A collaborative full-stack learning project for community volunteer activities, profiles, projects, and comments.

apps.title: MVC Film Site
apps.summary: A team Spring MVC film CRUD project whose current repository preserves documentation but not the application source.
